validation.scope: Synthetic temporary fixtures only; no production model, cache, fit payload, forecast payload or performance scores were opened.

reviewed_contracts: Every closed attempt is copied byte-for-byte, including inherited attempts without a current job ID; all elapsed charges and the original preparation charge remain counted.
Completed, failed and inference-unqualified immutable terminal states, results and finish times are retained; jobs without immutable terminal evidence remain pending.
Fit keys and native checkpoint, chain, phase, forecast, precision, example, history and selection artifacts are preserved; no fitting, forecasting or selection occurs.
Only required experiment, output and job identifiers are rebound. The frozen choices, scientific fields and original freeze creation time remain unchanged.
Original source records are archived. The new experiment has a new migration creation time, while the explicit original campaign clock remains unchanged.
A sufficiently recent genuine coordinator-closure receipt and every existing scheduler and fit-writer lock are required.
Application-time numerical runtime, cache, native-fit and forecast identities are checked, together with copied byte counts and checksums.
The original disk reserve remains enforced. Publication requires a new destination and atomic no-replace rename; there is no overwrite fallback.
Synthetic migrated evidence remains compatible with the existing compact-package verifier and report reader.

resolved_issue.description: Source attempt charges were summed in sorted filename order, but destination charges were summed in filesystem order and compared with exact floating-point equality. Identical receipts could therefore produce a false accounting failure.
resolved_issue.resolution: Both enumerations now use sorted filename order. Every elapsed_seconds value and original receipt byte is unchanged.
resolved_issue.regression: The preservation fixture reverses filesystem glob enumeration and verifies exact carried accounting.

limits: Production migration was pending at this review. This receipt does not certify that files were copied or that the new run started.
Application-time source/runtime/cache validation and real native checkpoint checks were mocked or exercised only on synthetic fixtures; actual apply must pass them independently.
The timing-projection artifact was not independently recomputed or inspected in this review. Its required hash and response-independent provenance checks were reviewed in the tool and configuration.
A metadata-only dry run does not establish actual copy integrity, runtime/cache compatibility, or production quiescence at a later time.
The limits are scheduling thresholds. Already admitted jobs retain the unchanged bounded in-flight allowance; actual cumulative consumption must be reported.
This is an operational review, not certification of MCMC qualification, forecast accuracy, completed scientific stages or final artifact delivery.
